_comment: Corpus sample registry and contract regression expectations. Drop <id>.png into inbox/ and run `npm run prototype:strip:corpus`. contract_expect is the verdict under current per-class budgets — update only when the contract changes. Pre-generation predictions are frozen in prediction-ledger.json.

samples.why: baseline sample the 0.28/0.15 budgets were derived from
curved limbless silhouette — gate must not be keyed to the miner's shape
legitimate color churn; honest stress test of the 0.15 drift budget
no planted baseline — tests an assumption the idle strip could not
a correct walk legitimately exceeds an idle-derived budget; failure here means budgets are per-motion-class
non-looping action; adjacent motion should stay sane while loop closure blows out
pose held, colors swapped — must trip drift and only drift
four different characters under a shared palette — silhouette must be what catches it

no transparent columns — must fail before the coherence gates, not silently yield one frame. A ground line spanning the canvas trips raw_clipping first (verified synthetically), so either layer is an acceptable catch
